algorithm_contract.attention: multi-head typed attention with node-type-specific K/Q/V and output projections plus edge-type-specific key/value transformations and attention priors
algorithm_contract.aggregation: add after attention softmax over incoming messages
algorithm_contract.metadata: ordered node-type strings and ordered (source_type,relation_type,destination_type) triplets
algorithm_contract.pyg_implementation_scope: The pinned HGTConv implements typed attention. Its forward signature has no temporal input and does not implement the paper's relative temporal encoding as a query field.

checkpoint_contract.fitted_artifact: project-generated per outer split, held-source role, and seed; not yet created
checkpoint_contract.warning: HGTConv is an encoder layer. PyG's pinned DBLP example supplies a node-classification head, not an evidence-graph link or gene-ranking model.

held_source_output_contract.admissible_output: one source-agnostic continuous candidate-gene score per frozen row, later calibrated without the held source
held_source_output_contract.held_edge_type_rule: A source encoded as a unique edge type owns HGT relation priors and key/value transformations. If every edge of that type is removed, those parameters receive no task evidence and cannot be used to score the unseen source.
held_source_output_contract.native_layer_output: a dictionary of node-type embedding tensors; a type that receives no messages may have no output
held_source_output_contract.required_decoder: A frozen source-agnostic gene-ranking decoder trained on eligible labels from remaining development sources only. It may not receive a held-source ID, held edge type, held observability, or outcome-derived node coverage.
held_source_output_contract.task_interpretation: Recovery is transfer from remaining typed evidence to evaluator-only support in a removed source, not inference with an untrained edge-type parameter.

inductive_transductive_contract.feature_based_operator: Conditionally inductive to new nodes of already trained node types when their feature transforms and incident relation types are frozen and available without held outcomes.
inductive_transductive_contract.new_edge_type: Unsupported. HGTConv metadata allocates edge-type-specific parameters at construction; an unseen type has no trained transformation.
inductive_transductive_contract.new_node_type: Unsupported. Node-type-specific projections and skip parameters are allocated from frozen metadata.
inductive_transductive_contract.official_example: Transductive node classification on one DBLP HeteroData graph with full graph features and split masks. It does not establish unseen-node or link-prediction behavior for this task.
inductive_transductive_contract.project_default: Use feature-based node inputs and a frozen type schema. Report any fixed-universe transductive lane separately.
inductive_transductive_contract.source_only_node_rule: A held-source-only node or node type cannot remain in the model input merely to preserve shape; its existence and type leak source coverage.

input_contract.continuous_edge_features: unsupported_by_HGTConv_forward; the API accepts edge_index_dict but no per-edge weight or feature dictionary
input_contract.edge_direction: native in ordered source-relation-destination triplets; reverse flow requires an explicit inverse triplet
input_contract.evidence_values: The operator learns one scalar attention prior per edge type and head. It does not consume assay strength, provenance confidence, tested-negative status, or missingness per edge.
input_contract.graph: one split-safe HeteroData-equivalent graph built only from permitted training sources and loci
input_contract.metadata_order_rule: Freeze exact list order as well as names. PyG maps edge triplets to parameter indices in metadata order.
input_contract.node_features: one floating-point feature tensor per node type, produced by source-independent or remaining-source transforms inside the outer training role

runtime_contract.optional_kernels: PyG documents pyg-lib and sparse extension packages as optional. Freeze the actual message-passing and sampling backend because kernel choice can affect runtime and numerical order.
runtime_contract.slurm_rule: No runtime or model probe before an approved campaign.

safe_loading_contract.state_dict_rule: Strict-load only project-generated tensor state into the frozen architecture. Do not deserialize arbitrary pickle-backed PyTorch objects.

source_evidence: The HGT paper, exact PyG 2.7.0 release commit, HGTConv source, official DBLP example, package metadata, and MIT license were inspected online on 2026-08-22. No package, graph, checkpoint, or weights were downloaded, installed, or run.

terms_audit.project_weight_redistribution: Code terms permit redistribution with notice, but a fitted artifact may encode project graph data. Release requires source-data rights review and the benchmark's dataset-level derivative-use review.
